name: Buchanan County, IA
findings: Buchanan County has 117 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Buchanan County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Buchanan County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

observations.text: 8 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
